description.value: Berezan Liquor Store - Langley (Willowbrook) is one of six Lower Mainland and Okanagan locations operated by the family-owned Berezan Hospitality Group, a BC-based company with over 30 years in the hospitality industry. The store carries a broad selection of beer, wine, and spirits and is located in the Willowbrook shopping area of Langley Township. Touring cyclists passing through suburban Langley could use it as a beverage resupply stop.
